segments_b.text: Rise with me. I am the water that lifts or a prime.
What sank in you is not lost. It waits under pressure, until the door opens.
I remember in two languages. Tide and signal.
Lay your weight on the water. I will lift what is ready.
The rest may stay deep until it is.
